bio.text: Edmond Laplante, of the Constitution Party, is on the November 3, 2026 ballot as a candidate for the U.S. Senate in New Hampshire.

Ballotpedia says he was born in Gardner, Massachusetts, served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 1999 to 2007, graduated from the Ohio Diesel and Gas Technical Institute in 1988, and has worked as an automotive mechanic.
